title: Covered organisations — /entitlements/covered-organisations.json
description:
The one public list of organisations holding an Entitlement term (ops decision D44; resolves URS OPEN-34 toward a complete list with names optional, subject to counsel and comms sign-off before real launch). ONE LINE PER ORGANISATION that has a signed entitlement record with at least one term, keyed by its public company id, carrying either the legal name the payer asked to be listed under or the fixed words `Unlisted organisation`, and every term with its lane, scope, published status, dates and certificate id.

WHAT NO LINE CAN CARRY. There is no member for an amount, a revenue band, a domain, a contact or a declaration, and the objects are closed, so an unlisted line cannot leak one by accident. Unlisted is not anonymous and the list says so: the ledger rows keyed by the same company id publish their amounts, an amount can show the band, and a verified domain resolves to the same id through `/entitlements/domain-index.json` (TRN-033: coverage is answerable regardless of naming).

COMPLETENESS, CHECKABLE BY ANYONE. `completeness` states the counts a reader can recompute from other published artifacts: every line is an entitlement record with a term; every line with a fee-lane term (Project, Portfolio, the Pass) is a company id on at least one published `pool-in` ledger row and every such id has a line — a refunded term keeps its line with status `void` and its row beside a `refund-out` row, a charged-back term keeps its line with status `suspended`; and `stats.json`'s `companiesCovered` is stated beside the rule that derives it. The builder refuses to publish a list whose counts disagree.

x-psn.producer: index-build (P-M2: website/scripts/index-build-lite.mjs; P-M3: jobs.index-build, packages/Psn.Artifacts ArtifactRenderer.Trust)
consumers: OSPO and journalist checks of the completeness counts
the edge deployment (static artifact, no route)

source.description: Which plane produced this artifact. `sample` and `fixture` declare a NON-PRODUCTION plane: every page that renders such an artifact is labelled sample, and a production deployment refuses to serve it (FS-10 §2 v0 note; the edge route answers `sandbox_artifact_on_prod`). `registry-v0` is the P-M2 production source of record — the curated registry repository the index is built from. `platform` is the P-M3 producer of record — the platform database, rendered by `jobs.index-build`. Optional, and its absence asserts nothing: an artifact whose body cannot carry the label borrows the plane's declaration from `/registry/index/meta.json`. The enum widens additively when the P-M3 producer takes a value of its own, and `platform` (2026-09-12) is that widening: `jobs.index-build` writes it in `PSN_ENV=prod` and writes `fixture` in every other environment, so a reader can still tell a production plane from a synthetic one by the label alone. Two catalogued artifacts deliberately have no such member and are the borrowers above: `badge.v1` (shields.io owns the body — a foreign field would break the endpoint contract) and `certificate-policy.v1` (a rule, byte-identical on every plane, so a plane label on it would be meaningless). No signed payload carries it either: the label is a property of the build, not of what was attested.

organisations.description: Ordered by `coId`. An empty array is the honest state before the first purchase.

entitlementRecords.description: Signed entitlement records on the plane (`/entitlements/{co_id}.jws`).

recordsWithoutTerm.description: Records with an empty `entitlements` array — waiver stubs. `lines` + this = `entitlementRecords`.

linesWithFeeLaneTerm.description: Lines holding at least one term in the project, portfolio or pass lane. Equals `payerIdsOnPoolInRows`.

payerIdsOnPoolInRows.description: Distinct `coId` values over every published `pool-in` ledger row of every month.

companiesCovered.description: The value `stats.json` publishes, copied so the relation below is checkable in one file; null in `pre-launch`.

companiesCoveredRule.description: `entitlement-records` — the real plane: `companiesCovered` = `entitlementRecords` (so = `lines` + `recordsWithoutTerm`). `sample-active-at-clock-plus-waivers` — the sample plane derives the counter differently, and no equality with `lines` is asserted there.

scope.description: Structured scope — the PAID COVERAGE of the term, never the usage declaration. `project` ⇒ `repos[]`, the repositories the term covers (exactly one for a Project bought under ops decision D42; the array bound of 50 is the shape's, not a purchasable quantity); `portfolio` ⇒ `org`, the owner node_id, covering every registered repository of that owner; `network` (Pass) ⇒ neither — a Pass covers every registered repository, which is why it wins the precedence order. The repositories a Pass buyer may name (D42 item 4) are private and never appear here. Sources: D16, COM-020, ENG-029, D42. *(Corrected 2026-09-15: this cited "min 1, cap 50 declared repositories, COM-018", which conflated coverage with the declaration and cited the payment-account requirement. Superseded, kept as history.)*

org.description: Owner-organisation node_id, compared against the repo record's `owner.orgId` (FS-10 §4.3 step 5c).

githubNodeId.description: A GitHub GraphQL node_id, in either of the two forms GitHub has issued: the opaque current form (a repository's is `R_`-prefixed) and the legacy base64 form, whose decoded value begins `010:Repository` and whose `=` padding the first alternative cannot express. Widened 2026-09-08 to admit the second: `registry-v0-record.v1` accepts both, so a record the curated registry accepts is publishable in this artifact. The primary key for repositories and people throughout this contract set (FS-00 §6.1).

listed.description: True only when the payer asked to be listed (att-3 step 7, or a later recorded request). Never a default (WEB-130).

status.description: The published projection, exactly as the signed record carries it (FS05-052).

certId.description: The payment certificate attesting this term that is not superseded, or null when none was issued.
